clauses.heading: Payment terms
clauses.text: Client shall pay each undisputed invoice within 90 days of receipt.

clauses.heading: Indemnification
clauses.text: Provider shall indemnify Client for all losses, without cap and without limit.

clauses.heading: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each party shall protect confidential information for three years after termination.

clauses.heading: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate for convenience on thirty days' written notice.

clauses.heading: Governing law
clauses.text: This agreement is governed by the laws of India, and the courts of Singapore shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

clauses.heading: Data processing
clauses.text: The provider may share personal data with affiliates, service providers and third parties for marketing.

clauses.heading: Non-compete
clauses.text: The consultant shall not compete for 36 months after termination.
